questions.prompt: Which of the following tasks is typically not a part of RTL synthesis?
How will a parameterized module (with a parameter named WIDTH) and having a port named A (with size WIDTH) be processed during elaboration in RTL synthesis?
options: Only one module with a fixed size for port A will be created for all WIDTH values.
Port A will be eliminated from the parameterized module.
Separate modules with different size of port A for each distinct value of WIDTH will be created.
The parameterized module will be ignored during elaboration.
questions.accepted: Separate modules with different size of port A for each distinct value of WIDTH will be created.

What is the primary motivation for resource sharing in RTL synthesis:
options: Increase the maximum operable frequency of the circuit.
Increase the testability of the circuit.
Improve the reusability of the circuit.

questions.prompt: An implicant of an incompletely specified Boolean function is a cube whose all corners are on:
Which of the following statements is incorrect regarding two-level logic minimization
options: The prime cover consists of only prime implicants.
There exists a minimum cover consisting of only prime implicants.
There exists a minimum cover consisting of only essential prime implicants.
All the essential prime implicants must be included in a prime cover.
questions.accepted: There exists a minimum cover consisting of only essential prime implicants.

questions.prompt: Which of the following statements is incorrect about the two-level heuristic minimizer
options: The cover size obtained using a heuristic minimizer can exceed the minimum cover.
Two-level heuristic minimizer typically produces solutions quicker than two-level exact minimization for large problems.
A heuristic minimizer typically tries to obtain a minimal cover by applying operators iteratively until the solution improves.
The cover produced by a heuristic minimizer is guaranteed to be the minimum cover.
questions.accepted: The cover produced by a heuristic minimizer is guaranteed to be the minimum cover.
